weaponMaster.lore: Lisää hyökkäysvahinkoasi ja hyökkäysluokitusta, kun käytät aseita ilman kilpeä.

charge.lore: Lataa eteenpäin jakele arkaanista vahinkoa ja upeita hirviöitä törmäyksessä.

devastatingCharge.lore: Kun lyöt hirviöitä Chargella, vapauta pulssi, joka tuottaa ylimääräistä arkaanista vahinkoa ja laskee hirviöhyökkäysarvoa.

defensiveShout.lore: Voimakas sotaharjoitus, joka vahvistaa sinun ja puolueesi jäsenten puolustusluokitusta.

odinsFury.lore: Tehokas sotajoukko, joka tekee salaperäisiä vahinkoja ja tainnuttaa ympärilläsi olevat hirviöt.

combatOrders.lore: Tehokas sotaharjoitus, joka piristää sinun ja puolueesi jäseniä maksimaalisen elämän ja manaan.

seismicSlam.lore: Murskaa hirviöitä edessäsi tekemällä vahinkoa ja lyömällä ne ylös ja hämmästyttäen ne.

bruteForce.lore: Lisää kriittisten iskujen ja kriittisten iskuvaurioiden mahdollisuutta.

zeal.lore: Iske kolme nopeaa ja tehokasta hyökkäystä parannetulla hyökkäysluokituksella.

monsterThrow.lore: Poimi ja heitä hirviö, joka tekee vaikutusalueen arkaanista vahinkoa ja tainnuttaa hirviöt laskeutuessaan.

ymirsChampion.lore: Suorita tehostettu kylmäisku lisäämällä kylmävaurioita, lisäämällä hyökkäysvahinkoa ja hyökkäysluokitusta. Hyökkäykset myös jäädyttävät hirviöitä ja kutsuvat pyörivän kirveen, joka tekee lisävahinkoa.

shockwave.lore: Murskaa maata aiheuttaen shokkiaallon, joka vaurioittaa vaikutusaluetta ja tainnuttaa hirviöt.

whirlwind.lore: Pyöritä aseitasi ympärilläsi ja vahingoita osumia hirviöitä.

berserk.lore: Jokainen onnistunut isku berserkillä lisää hyökkäysvahinkoasi, hyökkäysnopeutta ja liikkeen nopeutta, jolloin berserk pinoaa jopa 8 kertaa.

demolishingWinds.lore: Whirlwind päästää nyt valloilleen tornadot, jotka aiheuttavat osan Whirlwindin aiheuttamista vahingoista iskuille hirviöille.

blazingTrail.lore: Leave behind a trail of fire dealing fire damage to monsters.

fireEnchant.lore: Enchant your attacks with additive fire damage inflicting burning on monsters. Your spells also apply a stack of Ignite.

phoenixFlight.lore: Charge forward through the air dealing area of effect fire damage when landing.

infernoSlash.lore: Send forward a fire enchanted cleave attack dealing increased damage and additional fire damage.

ignite.lore: All fire enchanted attacks add a stack of ignite on the monster, causing them to combust at 10 stacks dealing area of effect fire damage.

fireShield.lore: Cast a shield of fire that increases your damage reduction and deals fire damage to monsters around you.

searingChains.lore: When striking a monster unleash a powerful chain attack dealing increased damage, additional fire damage and stunning monsters struck.

avatarOfFire.lore: Temporarily turns you into an avatar of fire; Increasing your attack speed, fire resistance and attack rating.

fireBall.lore: Cast a fireball dealing fire damage to monsters.

breathOfFire.lore: Breathe burning flames dealing fire damage and inflicting burning on hit.

meteor.lore: Cast a powerful meteor forwards dealing area of effect fire damage on impact.

scorchingAura.lore: Scorch monsters around you dealing fire damage.

hydra.lore: Spawn a fiery hydra that shoots fireballs with area of effect fire damage towards the closest monster.

comet.lore: Call down a huge comet exploding on impact dealing area of effect fire damage.

fireNova.lore: Cast a nova of fire around you dealing fire damage.

volcano.lore: Spawn a molten volcano that deals fire damage around it and spews out burning rocks that explode on hit.

armageddon.lore: Call down a rain of meteors from the sky dealing area of effect fire damage to monsters struck.

trickShot.lore: Shoot an arrow with increased attack rating that bounces from monster to monster dealing increased attack damage.

vault.lore: Vault in the direction aimed unleashing arrows towards nearby monsters dealing increased damage.

multishot.lore: Fire multiple arrows in an arc dealing increased damage.

arrowRain.lore: Unleash a rain of arrows from the sky dealing increased damage.

homingMissile.lore: Launch a barrage of homing missiles which seeks down its target dealing area of effect arcane and physical damage.

criticalAccuracy.lore: Increases your attack rating and critical strike damage.

arrowRampage.lore: Unleash a swarm of arrows towards the direction aimed dealing arcane and physical damage.

agility.lore: Temporarily increases your movement speed and attack speed.

volatileShot.lore: Fire a colossal arrow exploding on hit dealing area of effect damage.

arrowTurret.lore: Build an arrow turret that shoots arrows at the closest monster dealing arcane damage.

fragGrenade.lore: Throw a frag grenade dealing area of effect arcane damage launching shrapnel around.

beacon.lore: Build a beacon that increases nearby allies arcane skill damage and mana replenish.

cannonTurret.lore: Build a cannon turret that launches cannonballs towards the nearest monster that explode into shrapnel, dealing area of effect arcane damage.

turretMastery.lore: Increase arcane damage and attack speed of all turrets and drones.

rocketTurret.lore: Build a rocket turret that shoots rockets towards the nearest monster dealing area of effect arcane damage.

masterMechanic.lore: Temporarily increase the attack speed and arcane damage of all your turrets and drones!

gunnerDrone.lore: Build a gunner drone which follows you and shoots bullets that bounce from monster to monster dealing arcane damage.

buckshot.lore: Quick draw your musket and release a ranged buckshot with increased damage and additional fire damage.

grenado.lore: Blast yourself into the air leaving a cluster of grenades behind dealing fire damage.

explosiveBarrel.lore: Spawn a barrel of explosives which detonates after some time or when shot with a projectile dealing fire damage.

cannonball.lore: Shoot a cannonball that launches in the air on hit and deals area of effect damage when landing.

powderTrail.lore: Throw a keg of gunpowder causing a chain of explosions dealing fire damage.

kneeCap.lore: Increases your attack rating and chance for critical strike.

bombBarrage.lore: Start rapidly firing cannonballs dealing area of effect fire damage.

rapidFire.lore: Temporarily increase your attack speed and physical damage.

freezeChainShot.lore: Shoot a piercing chain shot that freezes and deals cold damage to monsters struck.

torrent.lore: Summon a pool of corrupted water on target location bursting into a massive torrent that knocks up monsters struck dealing cold damage.

frozenLead.lore: Use specially hand crafted frozen lead to increase your cold skill damage.

parrot.lore: Summon a parrot to peck your monsters dealing cold damage.

setSail.lore: Temporarily increases your cold skill damage and mana replenish.

anchorSwing.lore: Unleash a massive anchor swinging around you dealing cold damage.

remiges.lore: Increases your parrots cold damage and attack speed.

treasureHunter.lore: Search for a treasure from the corpses of dead monsters with additional magic find.

landAhoy.lore: Call for the main ship to bombard the targeted area dealing area of effect cold damage.

sandCarver.lore: Perform an attack that flings sand at monsters with increased damage and attack rating.

cloudOfSand.lore: Unleash a cloud of sand that travels forwards dealing arcane damage, by casting the skill again Nomad will re-locate on the sand clouds position dealing area of effect arcane damage and stunning nearby monsters.

sandEntombment.lore: Chance on kill to unleash a pulse of sand dealing arcane area of effect damage.

oasisAura.lore: When active, increases your and your party members attack rating and movement speed.

sandTremors.lore: Strike a target causing sand tremors to hit nearby monsters dealing increased damage and attack rating.

mysticSand.lore: Increases your arcane skill damage and cast rate.

dissipatingTornado.lore: Summon a dissipating tornado around you that pulls nearby monsters and causes you to dodge all attacks and unleash sand at monsters when they strike you dealing arcane damage.

sandVortex.lore: Summon a massive vortex of quick sand that pulls monsters inside dealing arcane damage.

bladeStrike.lore: Perform a cleave attack with increased chance for critical strike, critical strike damage and attack rating.

scimitarCharge.lore: Charge a short distance unleashing scimitar strike around you dealing increased damage to monsters struck.

eyeOfRa.lore: Perform a light enchanted attack bringing rays of sun down to nearby monsters dealing increased damage.

sunRay.lore: Increases your life and mana stolen per hit.

rupture.lore: Perform a rupturing area of effect attack inflicting bleed to targets on hit.

chainSlice.lore: Perform an enhanced attack that causes a sharp blade to chain between nearby monsters dealing damage.

phantomBlade.lore: Spawn a ghostly blade that attacks nearby monsters dealing increased damage and additional arcane damage.

hemorrhage.lore: Rupture inflicts armor break on all bleeding targets.

oilSpill.lore: Spill oil on the ground slowing and lowering monster attack rating. Oil also ignites into flames when coming in contact with Moonshine Molotov dealing additional burning damage.

pipeBombs.lore: Throw a barrage of handcrafted pipe bombs dealing area of effect fire damage.

moonshineMolotov.lore: Throw a bottle of moonshine that ignites the impacted area on fire and sends out burning oil.

tireFire.lore: Throw a truck tire that deals fire damage on hit.

hillbillyRage.lore: Temporarily increases your fire skill damage.

spontaneousCombustion.lore: When igniting oil in flames, also make the monsters combust dealing area of effect fire damage around them.

moonshineMadness.lore: Increases your attack rating and movement speed.

pickupRaid.lore: Call your hillbilly friends to siege your opponents in a pickup truck dealing fire damage.

chainsawSlash.lore: Perform an area of effect attack attaching a spinning chainsaw on monsters for a short period of time.

loggersEndurance.lore: Increases your life and life replenish.

experiencedLogger.lore: Increases your chance for critical strike and critical strike damage.

revvedUp.lore: Temporarily increases your attack speed and damage.

rogueChainsaw.lore: Throw a chainsaw on the ground spinning and dealing increased damage and additional arcane damage to monsters struck.

boneShred.lore: Unleash bone fragments dealing arcane damage to monsters.

meatBomb.lore: Throw a huge lump of meat that explodes on impact dealing arcane damage and leaving corpse on the ground.

poisonBreath.lore: Unleash a rotten breath of toxins dealing poison damage.

boneSpear.lore: Launch a piercing bone spear dealing arcane damage.

skeletonMastery.lore: Increases the life and arcane damage of all your summons.

lifeTap.lore: Curse monsters in the target area increasing any attackers life steal when striking the target.

summonFrenzy.lore: Temporarily enrage your summons increasing their attack speed and movement speed.

summonDamnedLegion.lore: Summon a damned legion to fight on your side.

summonResistances.lore: Increases all resistances and physical damage reduction of your summons.

summonVengefulSpirit.lore: Summon a vengeful spirit to fight on your side.

quickSlash.lore: Perform a quick dash unleashing area of effect slash dealing increased physical damage and knocking up monsters.

battleGlance.lore: Perform an area of effect attack with increased damage and attack rating.

shurikenThrow.lore: Throw three piercing Shurikens at your target dealing increased damage.

explosiveKunai.lore: Throw an explosive kunai that explodes on impact dealing area of effect arcane damage.

evasion.lore: Gain a chance to evade melee and ranged attacks.

smokeBomb.lore: Explode a smoke bomb dealing arcane damage.

bushido.lore: Activate to gain a buff that increases your attack damage for every 10% of missing Life.

liveByTheSword.lore: Temporarily increases your attack speed and movement speed.

bladeBarrier.lore: Summon a barrier of rotating blades around you dealing increased damage and additional arcane damage.

explodingBolas.lore: Throw bolas that deal arcane damage on impact and again when they explode after a short delay.

fanOfKnives.lore: Attacks have a chance to throw knives around you dealing damage to nearby monsters. Additionally the knives have a chance to ricochet to nearby monsters.

forHonor.lore: Temporarily increases your attack damage and movement speed.

omnislash.lore: Become untargetable and rapidly strike monsters multiple times with increased attack rating dealing increased damage.

burstOfSpeed.lore: Gain increased movement speed for a short period after killing a monster.

shadowStep.lore: Step into the shadows re-appearing at target location dealing area of effect damage and additional arcane damage to all nearby monsters.

wayOfTheWarrior.lore: Increases your attack damage and magic skill damage.

empiresSlash.lore: Perform an area of effect attack blinking a short distance and dealing damage to monsters in its path. Empire slash lowers Omnislashes cooldown when it strikes a monster.

vengeance.lore: Strike monsters with a lightning shock that splits towards nearby monsters, dealing increased damage and additive lightning damage.

thunderShield.lore: Cast a shield of thunder reducing magic damage taken and shocking monsters attacking you dealing lightning damage.

divineStorm.lore: Turn your attack into a divine storm dealing area of effect lightning damage around you.

fanaticismAura.lore: When active, increases your and your party members attack speed.

holyShockAura.lore: When active shock monsters around you dealing lightning damage.

lightningFury.lore: Strike monsters with increased attack damage causing lightning to chain between them dealing lightning damage.

ballLightning.lore: Turn into a ball of lightning and dash towards to the target location exploding for lightning damage to nearby monsters upon landing.

thorsFury.lore: Temporarily increases your attack speed and lightning skill damage.

holyBolt.lore: Cast a piercing bolt of holy light dealing arcane damage to monsters hit.

divineWisdom.lore: Increases your mana and mana replenish.

holyNova.lore: Cast a nova of holy light dealing arcane damage to monsters and healing all allies hit.

holyHammer.lore: Summon a holy hammer that spirals outwards dealing arcane damage on hit.

holyAura.lore: When active, increases your and your party members attack damage and magic skill damage.

fistOfTheHeavens.lore: Call down a fist of divine energy exploding into multiple Holy Bolts dealing arcane damage.

theVeneratedOne.lore: Temporarily increases your cast rate and mana replenish.

noxiousStrike.lore: Unleash a poisonous strike with increased damage and additional poison damage. Every third strike sends out piercing poisonous projectiles dealing damage and inflicting Poisoned on hit.

causticSpearhead.lore: Perform a burst attack dealing increased damage, additional poison damage and inflicting Poisoned on hit.

leapingAmbush.lore: Jump towards target location dealing poison damage and knocking up monsters around you upon landing.

deathFromAbove.lore: Call down a rain of falling spears on target location dealing poison damage and slowing monsters struck.

toxicRemains.lore: Chance on hit to unleash toxic gas inflicting Poisoned on monsters hit.

jungleCamouflage.lore: Temporarily increases your poison skill damage.

envenom.lore: On monster kill you have a chance to explode toxic fissures on all monsters around thje target dealing poison damage and inflicting Poisoned.

astropesGift.lore: Perform a lightning enhanced attack with increased damage and additive lightning damage.

feint.lore: Gain a chance to evade melee and ranged attacks.

rebound.lore: Perform an attack with increased damage and additional lightning damage that rebounds to the closest monster.

spearnage.lore: Furiously throw lightning enchanted spears towards target location.

stormDash.lore: Dash towards target location striking nearby monsters with chain lightning.

chooserOfTheSlain.lore: Increases your life and mana after kill.

thunderFury.lore: Perform an attack with increased damage that spreads lightning behind the target.

astropesBattleMaiden.lore: Temporarily increases your lightning skill damage and attack speed.

triggerFinger.lore: Fire a burst shot with increased attack damage and attack rating.

eagleEye.lore: Increases your attack damage, additional physical damage and critical strike damage when using ranged weapons.

execute.lore: Deal extra attack damage to monsters below 30% Life.

bulletHell.lore: Fire a barrage of bullets towards the aimed direction dealing increased damage.

possessedBullet.lore: Fire a satanic bullet possessed by darkness which explodes into multiple bullets on impact dealing damage.

demonsPresence.lore: Temporarily increase your attack speed and attack damage.

concentrationAura.lore: When active, increases your and your party members attack rating.

absoluteMayhem.lore: Harness the power of your inner demon and fire multiple massive bullets in a line dealing increased damage.

fastSlices.lore: Perform a series of dashing attacks, dealing area of effect damage on second attack and stunning monsters around you on the final attack.

demonsCalling.lore: Become airborne and smash the ground dealing area of effect arcane damage and stunning monsters around you.

heartAttack.lore: Increases your chance for critical strikes and critical strike damage when using a melee weapon.

shadowAnomalies.lore: Casting Demon's Calling now spawns five shadow anomalies that perform Demon's Calling with increased arcane damage.

soulLeech.lore: Leech life out of monsters in target area dealing arcane damage and healing you.

swordHandler.lore: Increases your life stolen per hit, attack rating and damage when using swords.

demonsShield.lore: Increases all resistances and movement speed.

sliceOfShadows.lore: Perform an attack that releases a wave of shadow dealing increased damage.

demonForm.lore: Temporarily turn into a demon gaining increased attack damage and attack speed.

boneFragments.lore: Cast fragments of bone towards target location dealing arcane damage.

impale.lore: Summon spikes from the ground impaling monsters in a target area dealing arcane damage and knocking them up.

ossification.lore: Increases your defense and gives you a burst of movement speed after killing a monster.

singleOut.lore: Monsters that have no other monsters around them take increased arcane damage.

ominousPresence.lore: When active, increases your and your party members arcane skill damage.

twisters.lore: Unleash small twisters towards target location dealing arcane damage to monsters on their path.

rockFragments.lore: Unleash rock fragments towards target location dealing arcane damage.

tornado.lore: Summon a tornado traveling towards target direction dealing arcane damage to monsters on its path.

earthsGrace.lore: Increases your maximum life and mana.

fissures.lore: Rip the ground open with magic causing cracks that release fissures dealing arcane damage.

earthTotem.lore: Summon a totem that fires rock fragments that deal area of effect arcane damage on hit.

spiritualGuide.lore: Increases your mana and mana replenish.

spiritWolves.lore: Spawn a spirit wolf to fight on your side.

scentOfTheWolf.lore: Increases spirit wolves arcane damage and life.

stormTotem.lore: Summon a totem that releases chain lightning on nearby monsters dealing lightning damage.

fireTotem.lore: Spawn a totem that casts piercing fire projectiles dealing fire damage.

martyr.lore: Sacrifice your own blood when taking damage from any source temporarily increasing your life and mana replenish.

malediction.lore: Your unholy essence drives birds into insanity, casts have a chance to send crows towards random nearby monsters combusting into arcane damage on impact.

heavenlyFire.lore: Light the target location into holy fire dealing arcane damage.

burstOfLight.lore: Cast a ray of divine light dealing arcane damage and lights monsters on heavenly fire.

flashHeal.lore: Heal yourself and any nearby allies.

benediction.lore: When healed by your abilities, smite monsters around you with holy lightning.

divineHealing.lore: Using flash heal temporarily increases your life replenish.

chainOfHolyLight.lore: Cast a holy lightning jumping from monster to monster dealing arcane damage.

holyShield.lore: By the power of god bless yourself and any nearby allies with immortality for a short period.

healingZone.lore: Bless the area around you with divine energy healing yourself and nearby allies.

heavyBall.lore: Flail a big chained spike ball dealing damage to monsters on its path.

bombardment.lore: Rapidly throw a barrage of small bombs in target direction dealing area of effect fire damage.

forceOverwhelming.lore: Temporarily increase your attack damage, attack rating and attack speed.

titaniumChains.lore: Monsters affected by Serrated Chains explode upon death dealing physical damage.

masterTrapMaker.lore: Passively increases the arcane damage dealt by chain traps and provides a chance for critical hits as well as a proc chance for traps to activate rapidly causing the trap and its hooks to travel faster.

rendFlesh.lore: Attacks have a chance to inflict bleeding on monsters in a small area around the target.

madnessControl.lore: Hook nearby monsters towards you stunning them and dealing arcane damage. Additionally summon a bomb from the sky onto your location dealing area of effect arcane damage.

defunctSurgeon.lore: Temporarily increase your attack speed and life stolen per hit. When active lose a portion of your maximum life per second (Non-fatal).

crematus.lore: Unleash a breath of toxic flames dealing poison damage.

oops.lore: Toxic flask also leaves a pool of poisonous substance on the ground dealing poison damage, plaguing and slowing monsters. Oops.

chantOfWeakness.lore: Plagued targets take increased poison damage.

honedDefenses.lore: Every time you get hit by a monster attack gain stacks. At maximum stacks unleash a huge area of effect pulse dealing arcane damage to monsters around you. Can also be casted early to consume the stacks.

shieldWall.lore: Cast a wall of shields around you blocking monster projectiles dealing arcane and physical damage on hit.

knightsVigor.lore: Gain increased maximum life and vitality.

lastStand.lore: Restore yourself to full life and temporarily gain increased magic skill damage and physical damage reduction.

sandGuardian.lore: Conjure a Sand Guardian that attacks nearby monsters dealing arcane damage.

piercingSand.lore: Sand Guardians break monster arcane resistances on attack.

callForWar.lore: Command all Sand Guardians to charge to target area. Passively increases Sand Guardian dash range.

linkOfSand.lore: Pull yourself into the closest Sand Guardian in the target location temporarily empowering all nearby Sand Guardians arcane damage.

dissipation.lore: Sand Guardians explode upon expiration dealing area of effect arcane damage.

spiritLink.lore: Link of Sand now increases your magic skill damage and physical damage reduction for a short period.

cheapShot.lore: Sand Guardians gain a chance to deal a deadly attack with increased arcane damage and stunning their target.

circleOfGuardians.lore: Conjure a circle of Sand Guardians around you increasing Sand Guardians’ arcane damage.

combatOrder.lore: Sand Guardians gain a chance to perform an area of effect attack dealing arcane damage.

ageProliferation.lore: Channel waves of fractal energy on the target monster sending pulses out dealing arcane damage to nearby monsters.

gravitationalSlam.lore: Raise monsters in target location into the air smashing them down with quantum force dealing arcane damage.

splitReality.lore: Detach from your quantum self leaving your fractal self behind that explodes when coming in contact with a monster dealing arcane damage.

sandsOfTime.lore: Temporarily increase your arcane skill damage and cast rate.

timeDeceleration.lore: Break time and space causing all nearby monsters to take arcane damage and Slowing them.

dimensionalDisplacement.lore: Warp a short distance towards target location temporarily gaining increased movement speed.

expansiveMind.lore: Increases your mana and mana replenish.

temporalHeroes.lore: Summon a fractal Viking, Pyromancer and Marksman to fight on your side.

frozenBoulder.lore: Throw a frozen boulder dealing cold damage to monsters on its path.

breathOfIce.lore: Breathe glacial air freezing and dealing cold damage to monsters.

powerOfTheAncients.lore: Gain additional cold skill damage based on your mana.

orbOfFrost.lore: Cast a frozen orb traveling in target direction releasing icicles, freezing and dealing cold damage to monsters on its path.

frozenHide.lore: Cast a frost enhanced shield on yourself reducing incoming physical damage, freezing and dealing cold damage to monsters that attack you.

icicles.lore: Every 5th time you cast a spell also release Icicles dealing cold damage.

portalOfIce.lore: Teleport to the target location and release a frost nova dealing cold damage.

blizzard.lore: Cast a freezing blizzard dealing area of effect cold damage and freezing monsters in the target area.

glacialTremors.lore: Every 4th attack unleashes an area of effect blast dealing cold damage.

flashFreeze.lore: Perform an attack enhanced with ice that unleashes a chaining orb of ice, exploding into icicles at the end dealing additional cold damage.

freezingLeap.lore: Leap through the air into target location freezing and dealing cold damage to monsters when landing.

permaFrost.lore: Frozen monsters have a chance explode into an area of effect pulse when shattered.

frostSunder.lore: Unleash a barrage of piercing icicles dealing cold and physical damage freezing on hit.

avalanche.lore: Release a bellowing shout dealing cold damage to all monsters around you.

absoluteZero.lore: Break monster cold resistances on attack.

theEmbodimentOfAurgelmir.lore: Summon the power of Aurgelmir and temporarily turn into a war machine of the frozen tundra increasing your attack damage, attack speed and life replenish.

scorchingWhip.lore: Cast a scorching solar flare that whips forward dealing fire damage to monsters hit.

whiplash.lore: Scorching Whip now creates a chaining fire ball that bounces between monsters. Fire balls can hit the same target multiple times.

solarFlare.lore: Unleash solar flare projectiles that homes towards monsters.

shineBright.lore: Gain increased movement speed and attack speed.

solarDash.lore: Turn into a burning ball of fire traveling towards target location dealing fire damage leaving a trail of flames behind you.

blindingLight.lore: You emit a blinding light that gives you chance to evade monster attacks. You also have increased cast rate while in Solar Form

solarForm.lore: Turn into a living sun and gain additional fire damage. Every time you cast an active ability in solar form you unleash a fiery pulse around you.

solarBurst.lore: When you kill a monster, summon a burning burst of solar fire beneath the dead monster that deals area of effect fire damage.

supernova.lore: Explode into a supernova dealing fire damage on a large radius.

collision.lore: Leap forward from your orbit and smash the ground dealing area of effect cold damage. Then dash forward on the surface of earth for short period of time and deal cold damage.

darkSideofTheMoon.lore: While active, slow monsters around you and increase your mana replenish.

tsunami.lore: Direct your lunar mass to cast a wave of tsunami forward dealing cold damage.

asteroid.lore: Cast down an asteroid from the sky dealing cold damage when landing.

lunarForm.lore: Turn into a living moon and gain additional cold damage. Every time you jump, cast Collision instead.

lunarOrbit.lore: Unleash small moons in your orbit dealing cold damage on hit.

bloodMoon.lore: Turn the orbiting moons into blood moons increasing their cold damage and causing them to inflict bleeding on hit.

moonlight.lore: Increases your movement speed and cold damage dealt.

blackHole.lore: Cast a black hole on target location that slows and pulls monsters towards it dealing cold damage.

slicingThrow.lore: Throw your weapon like a boomerang returning back to you dealing physical damage to monsters on its path. You can activate Daisy's Call to re-appear where the last thrown slicing throw is at any point in the flight.

furiousStrike.lore: Perform a powerful area of effect attack dealing increased damage and infecting monsters struck with a stack of rabies. Each stack of rabies increases attack damage dealt to the monster.

holyForm.lore: Activate Holy Form gaining increased life replenish and life steal at the cost of damage dealt. Any damage dealt while in this form is decreased.

unholyForm.lore: Activate Unholy Form gaining increased damage at the cost inflicting a portion of your max life as damage to your self every time you cast, attack or proc something. Any life replenish when in this form is lowered.

sacrilegiousScorn.lore: While in Holy Form gain increased attack speed and while in Unholy Form gain increased Critical damage.

endingFate.lore: While in Holy Form gain increased base life regen after killing a monster and while in Unholy Form rip the monster apart after killing a monster causing huge area of effect damage.

spiritualDuality.lore: While in Holy Form increases your life Per Hit and while in Unholy Form increases your attack damage.

awakeningFury.lore: On hit gain a chance to increase your attack damage for a short duration.

insatiableHunger.lore: Awaken the full potential of both holy and unholy to gain both benefits for a short period of time with increased effectiveness.

chainRip.lore: Perform a powerful attack pulling all nearby monsters infront of you.

brutalizingSlash.lore: Attack with brutalizing area of effect attack causing monsters to bleed.

fuelToFire.lore: Increase your damage dealt for a short period of time. Every corpse close to you will be siphoned for additional damage.

hungerForBlood.lore: Deal increased damage to bleeding targets.

butchersHook.lore: Flail a huge meat hook around you gathering all monsters struck then pulling and stunning them infront of you.

chainSwing.lore: Throw a meat hook that pulls you into it when connecting with monster or environment. Additionally fires chains to nearby monsters when landing.

submergedKnives.lore: Smash the ground pushing waves of butchers knives out of the ground dealing massive damage. Deals extra damage to bleeding targets.

enragedMania.lore: Increase attack area of effect range and attack speed.

blender.lore: Swing two huge butchers knives around you dealing physical damage.

chargedBolts.lore: Unleash multiple sparking bolts of electricity dealing lightning damage on hit.

manaFiend.lore: Reduce the mana cost of all skills.

pulsingCharge.lore: Charged bolts pulse when hitting a monster.

lightningSurge.lore: Unleash a surge of lightning dealing lightning damage.

chainLightning.lore: Lightning Surge now unleashes chain lightning when colliding with a monster.

staticShock.lore: Shock target location with static electricity inflicting monsters with static shock dealing lightning damage over time.

stormCloud.lore: Conjure a storm cloud at target location striking monsters with surges of lightning dealing lightning damage.

symphonyOfThunder.lore: Gain increased lightning damage for a short period of time also zapping all monsters with thunderbolts when hit by a lightning skill.

electricCells.lore: Gain increased flat mana replenish and energy.

stormBolt.lore: Unleash a bolt of lightning dealing area of effect lightning damage.

highVoltageAura.lore: Increases your and party members lightning skill damage.

loadedPulse.lore: Storm Bolt now creates an additional static pulse dealing increased area of effect lightning damage.

waveLength.lore: Increases the projectile speed of all skills.

theBatteryWithin.lore: Gain increased life, mana and all resistances.

hyperCharged.lore: Chance on Cast to gain increased faster cast rate for a short period of time.

apocalypticThunder.lore: Cast a high voltage thunder bolt on target spot stunning and dealing massive area of effect damage.

afterShock.lore: Chance on kill to cast Apocalyptic Thunder on the closest monster with increased lightning damage.

slayingRiffs.lore: Drop an amplifier from the sky smashing the ground and send notes towards it dealing lightning damage. Dropping an amplifier on another one causes it to explode.

insaneRiff.lore: Every fifth spell cast is empowered.

visceralGrowl.lore: Unleash a visceral growl in a frontal cone dealing lightning damage.

ampingUp.lore: Chance on spellhit or strike to gain a stack of amping up increasing your cast rate for a short duration.

sacrilegiousSymphony.lore: Channel for a brief moment before unleashing a massive area of effect pulse around you dealing lightning damage.

satansMelody.lore: Gain increased lightning skill damage for a short duration and a chance to unleash guitar picks in an arc on hit.

soundsOfSilence.lore: Converts a portion of your intelligence into lightning skill damage.

highDb.lore: Notes have a chance to unleash a sonar pulse on hit dealing increased lightning damage.

progeniesOfTheGreatCataclysm.lore: Summon a massive amplifier playing black metal at high volume sending piercing notes towards nearby monsters bouncing from terrain dealing lightning damage. If you are too far from the amplifier it is pulled back to your position.

headBanger.lore: Every third attack unleashes a headbang dealing area of effect damage.

crowdPummeler.lore: chance to unleash notes from monsters on hit dealing physical damage.

crowdDiver.lore: Charge towards target location knocking monsters up on hit dealing physical damage.

adrenalineMomentum.lore: chance to gain a stack of adrenaline momentum on hit increasing your movement speed and attack speed.

cravingForAttention.lore: Gain fire skill damage for a portion of your total enhanced damage.

pyroTechnician.lore: Blink into the closest monster to target location unleashing an area of effect attack dealing physical and fire damage.

cravingForAnotherKilling.lore: Increases your attack damage, life per hit and attack speed for a short duration.

antiSocialPitFighter.lore: Chance to apply increased magic find on kill.

moshpitMassacre.lore: Summon a death metal crowd to fight monsters within the area radius draining a portion of your maximum mana over time dealing physical damage.

carrionWorm.lore: Summons a carrion worm frequently attacking nearby monsters.

thornedRoots.lore: Unleash a swarm of roots dealing poison damage on hit.

raven.lore: Summon a raven circling around you attacking nearby monsters.

summonEnt.lore: Summons an ent to fight by your side.

thornedBranch.lore: Throw a thorned branch dealing poison damage on hit.

spiritOfForest.lore: Summons a spirit of the forest increasing life and mana for you and your party.

entColossus.lore: Summons an ent colossus to fight by your side.

spiritOfWendigo.lore: Morph into a wendigo gaining increased combat stats.

woundingPaw.lore: Strike monsters with increased damage with a chance to unleash a ripple of blood.

skinWalker.lore: A portion of your life is added as physical damage.

leapingCharge.lore: Perform a charging leap forward inflicting physical damage to monsters on hit.

spiritOfEnt.lore: Morph into an Ent with a chance to knock monsters back on hit stunning and dealing additional damage when colliding with terrain.

maelstromOfFrost.lore: Summon a maelstrom of frost around you inflicting cold and physical damage on hit.

manaDwelling.lore: Adds a portion of your mana as physical damage.

spiritOfHawk.lore: Morph into a storm hawk gaining flying and convert a portion of your physical damage into lightning damage. Your attacks now unleash a chain lightning.
